newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mine accident kills seven, injures 10.
newsitem.headline: Peru mine accident kills seven, injures 10.

text.p: An explosion at a small Peruvian mine in the highland province of Puno killed seven workers and injured 10 others, state news agency Andina said Tuesday.
"The explosion, that occurred last Sunday, was caused, according to preliminary investigations, by a bad handling of of the dynamite inside one of the mine's tunnels," Andina said.
The agency added that accidents like the one at La Rinconada mine were common in the area where 5,000 small miners "use dynamite without control or experience."
Officials could not say what metal was extracted at the La Rinconada, but most of the small mines in the zone are for gold.
During 1994 and 1995, 364 miners died in accidents in Peru.
